# Pirate Ship Higemaru, Vulgus and additional 1942 sets

This release adds Pirate Ship Higemaru, four additional versions of 1942, three versions of Vulgus, and Mach-9, a Vulgus bootleg. The nine new entries use `jt1942_llapi21.rbf`. The previously released 1942 (Revision B) entry keeps its existing menu path, settings and core binary.

The game-specific control tests exercised Action on Higemaru, Shoot and Bomb on Vulgus, and rotation on Vulgus set 2. LLAPI 2P uses driver 1.0.0 with Immediate Repoll enabled. Show Credits on Pause defaults to Off. On SNAC, hold an action button and tap Start three times to toggle autofire for that action. Release the action to stop firing, and repeat the gesture to restore manual input. Testing on a physical MiSTer is pending.

Quartus Prime Lite 20.1.1 Build 720 accepted seed 1 with setup margin +0.415 ns and hold margin +0.184 ns. The RBF is 2,886,048 bytes. Its SHA-256 is `f89b7770b6ddd3482e41acae0a9edfc02d5903d7b2c0001a898fb581cbbc4d55`.
